name: [UPD]Pupi Midnight Munchie
desc:
Welcome to Pupi’s place, where you work "ENDLESS"ly.

⚠️Pre-Alpha Warning⚠️: The game is in early development. There will be bugs, glitches, and sudden updates are part of the process. This game was made by 1 Developer with low experience. Thanks for your understanding.

This game is quite grinding. And also, a joke game, please don't take it seriously!

You MUST survive and keep working in these mysterious places. Something is not right about this place. Be prepare..

Providing customer service to earn points and other currencies.
Use your point to activate your skill to defend yourself from danger or help your employee friends.

Those places sometimes light out. You've got to go repair the generator before bad things happen.
